BiblicalUsage: Yattîyr is the Aramaic word for preeminent, for what stands out above the rest. Nebuchadnezzar's image was great and its brightness excellent, and the furnace was made exceeding hot for Shadrach, Meshach and Abed-nego.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe what stands out in Babylon is not the image but the three men who would not bow to it.
